My dear [Miss Holbeche](/person/2078),
I send some stamps from a Miss Murray at Brighton for your poor blind friend, and by the same post your 13 copies of the [Last Heartsease Leaves](/book/45), with many thanks for your kindness in disposing of them, I hope they will not prove so small as to be very disappointing
With many thanks

yours sincerely

C M Yonge


[^1]: The letter is evidently addressed to the author of \'Blindness: Its Trials and Blessings\' MP (July 1861) 91-99.
